MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW (2026-07-07)

Market regime is UPTREND (SPY +2.0% vs SMA50, 20d slope +3.76%) — a supportive backdrop, but not a license to force trades.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: Portfolio is 89% deployed across 5 positions with only $6,357 headroom for new buys. Proper 1.5% risk sizing on any quality candidate requires ~$20-25k in capital (for a stock with 6% stop distance). At $6,357 headroom, a new position would represent <0.5% risk — statistically meaningless and not worth the commission friction or mental overhead. The capacity constraint alone makes new BUYs inadvisable this cycle.

HISTORICAL PERFORMANCE WARNING: 14.3% win rate and Sortino -3.81 are alarming signals. Five consecutive stop-outs (FICO, IQV, ADP, MSFT, ZBRA) suggest either entries are too early, stops too tight relative to volatility, or both. The system's own backtest shows no edge over buy-and-hold SPY. This demands more patience and higher conviction thresholds — NOT more trades.

EXISTING POSITION ASSESSMENT:
— AMP (+12.85%): Clear winner. Thesis intact. Should trail stop up to protect gains; suggest trailing to ~$455 (just below recent consolidation, ~10% below current price).
— LII (+3.19%): HVAC compounder, uptrend basing, thesis intact. Hold.
— A (+0.69%): Agilent basing in uptrend, thesis intact but slow. Hold with patience — earnings not until Aug 26.
— FDS (+2.59%): Now 'extending' per trend data, +9.3% above SMA50 with 5.1% ATR. Not chasing further. Hold with existing stop; do NOT add.
— CI (+0.04%): Essentially flat since entry. Health insurance sector faces persistent regulatory and political headwinds (Medicaid reform, ACA uncertainty). Zero price momentum. This is dead money risk. No thesis break confirmed yet, but CI is on watch — if price drops below $270 or sector news deteriorates, exit immediately. Do not add.

NEW CANDIDATES REVIEW: Several intriguing setups exist (VEEV, EMR, DHR) but cannot be sized properly with $6,357 remaining headroom. MU, FLEX, MRVL, AMAT are extended (>70% of 52w range, >15% above SMA50) — hard AVOID per rules. COF and DHR have earnings in 14 days — poor entry timing. ZBRA just stopped us out; re-entry too soon. The honest answer is: no asymmetric setup exists that can be sized correctly given current capacity.

CONCLUSION: Hold existing 5 positions. Tighten AMP trailing stop. Watch CI closely. Zero new trades this cycle. Protect the capital — the cash buffer and low portfolio heat (1.77%) are features, not bugs.
